title: On the Ordering and Injectivity of Lagrange Constants Associated with Certain Substitutions
summary: Motivated by the modern characterization of the Markoff spectrum via mechanical words and the Markoff Uniqueness Conjecture, we study the Lagrange constants of continued fractions generated by a parameterized family of substitutions $φ_{a,b}$ defined by $0 \mapsto aa$ and $1 \mapsto bb$ with $b = a + 1$. Based on a three-fold arithmetic classification of pairs of rational numbers $0 \le x a$, highlighting a sharp phase transition in ordering behavior at the boundary $b = a^2 + 2$.
